mentions.name: Bread Recipe Sharing Community
mentions.description: A community platform for sharing and iterating on bread recipes, which the author built to record their own recipes and is now close to publicly releasing.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a bread recipe community where you can share and iterate on bread recipes. It's out of personal interest to be able to record my bread recipes and thought it might be interesting for others too.
